description: Search job vacancies on hh.ru by keywords, region, professional role, industry, metro, salary, experience, employment form, work format, date range and labels. Returns a compact paginated summary (pass raw:true for full JSON).

area.description: Region code (1=Moscow, 2=Saint Petersburg). Use get_areas / suggest_areas to find codes.

currency.description: Salary currency (RUR, USD, EUR). Only applied when salary is set; defaults to RUR.

date_from.description: Published from this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-06-01). Mutually exclusive with period.

date_to.description: Published up to this date (ISO 8601). Mutually exclusive with period.

employer_id.description: Restrict results to a single employer id.

employment.description: DEPRECATED by hh.ru — prefer employment_form. Still accepted.

employment_form.description: Employment form (modern replacement for the deprecated `employment`).

industry.description: Industry id (employer industry). Use get_industries to find ids.

label.description: Vacancy label filter (replaces the deprecated only_with_salary — use with_salary).

metro.description: Metro station or line id. Use get_metro to find ids.

period.description: Only vacancies published within the last N days (1-30). Mutually exclusive with date_from/date_to.

professional_role.description: Professional role id. Use get_professional_roles / suggest_positions to find ids.

raw.description: Return the full raw hh.ru JSON instead of the compact summary.

salary.description: Desired salary amount (sent together with currency).

schedule.description: DEPRECATED by hh.ru — prefer work_format. Still accepted.

search_field.description: Restrict the text search to a single field.

text.description: Search query. Supports hh.ru query language (quotes, AND/OR/NOT, field:). e.g. "python AND django"

work_format.description: Work format (modern replacement for schedule=remote etc.).

name: search_vacancies
